copy.headline: ‘Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping’ Slays $120M at Box Office as Franchise Heats Back Up
copy.caption: The sixth film in the Lionsgate series rebounded after 2023's 'The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes,' while freshly expanded 'I Play Rocky' and newcomer 'Elsinore' also came out swinging.
